$meta.name: Terres Design Tokens
$meta.description: Single source of truth for Terres. v2.0.0 ports SaaS-grade grammar (granular type scale, 4px-base spacing rhythm, tight radii, hairline-first elevation, mono for data) onto the warm Terres palette. v2.4.0 absorbs the Stripe→Terres craft transfer (brief firewall §0: take the discipline — spacing rhythm, hierarchy-by-size, motion restraint, proof-by-numbers — NOT the assets: no blurple, mesh gradient, skew, navy, Söhne, or blue shadow): adds semantic motion durations (--motion-hover/reveal/sheet) + the --ease-out-quart signature easing, upgrades --shadow-sm/md to the warm two-layer (burgundy) anatomy, and remaps the 3D map/parcel layer to the canonical orange scale. Spacing/radius reconciliation: ONE canonical value each — spacing is the 4px-base scale (8px structural rhythm, 2/4px optical subpasos via --space-05/--space-1); radii poles are --radius-sm 4px (controls) and --radius-lg 12px (cards), --radius 8px in-product default. Stripe's 16px card radius is rejected in favor of the single Terres 12px. New craft pieces must NOT redefine these tokens inline — reference colors_and_type.css. Hand-edit this file, then run `node build.mjs` to regenerate the CSS mirrors — do not edit them directly.

primary.comment: Brand orange — CTA, institutional block, active product state

primary-foreground.comment: Cream on orange. 2.78:1 — EXCEPCION DE MARCA FIRMADA (audit 2026-06-02): no cumple WCAG AA, autorizada solo para wordmark/bloque institucional, nunca texto de lectura ni <24px. Override a --foreground en pliegos publicos/RFP. No overridear por bloque.

secondary.comment: Burgundy P20 — secondary buttons, strong tags, table-header fills

secondary-foreground.comment: Texto/ícono sobre el botón secundario burgundy.

card.comment: Fondo de card en producto = cream. Mantenido por paridad shadcn (audit 2026-06-02).

card-foreground.comment: Texto sobre card. Mantenido por paridad shadcn.

popover.comment: Editorial light cream — popovers, menus, also valid page bg for long editorial pieces

popover-foreground.comment: Texto sobre popover. Mantenido por paridad shadcn.

editorial-light.comment: Allowed page background for any long editorial piece: PDFs, .docx, press notes, long landings

surface-raised.comment: v2 — elevated surface inside product (header bars, sticky rails) one step lighter than page

surface-sunken.comment: v2 — recessed surface (table zebra, well, code block bg)

muted.comment: Fondo apagado: wells, zebra de tabla, chips neutros.

accent.comment: Realce sutil: hover de fila, fondo de tag, bloque de énfasis suave.

accent-foreground.comment: Texto sobre accent. Mantenido por paridad shadcn.

border.comment: Warm beige hairline — the v2 default separator. Never cold gray

border-strong.comment: v2 — emphasized hairline (top rule of a table, active divider)

input.comment: Borde por defecto de inputs y campos.

ring.comment: Color del halo de foco en cualquier elemento interactivo.

destructive.comment: Cold red — must not be confused with brand orange

destructive-hover.comment: Hover del botón destructive. Rojo más oscuro; no hay escala roja propia (audit 2026-06-02).

destructive-subtle.comment: v2 — tinted bg for destructive chips / inline error rows

success.comment: Olive — the only green in the system

success-foreground.comment: Texto sobre success solido. Mantenido por paridad shadcn (los chips usan success-subtle + texto solido).

success-subtle.comment: v2 — tinted bg for success chips / valid input

info.comment: v2 — petrol. The one cool hue: info states + data 2-series counterpoint to orange

info-foreground.comment: Texto sobre info solido. Mantenido por paridad shadcn.

info-subtle.comment: v2 — tinted petrol bg for info chips / callouts

warning.comment: v2 — deep amber/ochre. Distinct from brand orange (which is red-orange)

warning-foreground.comment: Texto sobre warning solido. Mantenido por paridad shadcn.

warning-subtle.comment: v2 — tinted amber bg for warning chips

chart-2.comment: v2 — petrol. The cool counterpoint for clean 2-series comparison

chart-5.comment: Roast — sin paso de escala propio

map-land.comment: Relleno de manzanas/tierra en el mapa.

map-water.comment: Warm neutral — Terres maps stay blue-free even in v2

map-parcel.comment: Relleno de la parcela activa/seleccionada (reposo, fill 0.18).

map-parcel-line.comment: v2.4 — contorno de la parcela objetivo (line-layer 2D, reposo · 2px).

map-context-line.comment: v2.4 — contorno del catastro vecino (line 0.8 · opacity 0.35). Mismo rol que --map-stroke.

map-volume-1.comment: v2.4 — volumen 3D fill-extrusion: cuerpo / piso par (opacity 0.95).

map-volume-2.comment: v2.4 — volumen 3D: piso impar. Remapeo del #D86200 fuera de escala → orange-600 (0.95).

map-volume-3.comment: v2.4 — volumen 3D: retiro 1. Remapeo del #C25600 fuera de escala → orange-700 (0.92).

map-volume-4.comment: v2.4 — volumen 3D: retiro 2. Remapeo del #A84A00 fuera de escala → orange-800 (0.92).

map-parcel-hover.comment: v2.4 — feature-state hover de parcela (fill 0.28 · outline orange-600 2px).

shadow-xs.comment: Hairline lift — rarely needed, prefer a border

shadow-sm.comment: v2.4 — warm de dos capas (borgoña): bottom tenue + top difusa, spread negativo. Resting card en producto. Hairline-first sigue primero.

shadow-md.comment: v2.4 — warm de dos capas (borgoña). Hovered card, popover, dropdown.

shadow-xl.comment: v2 — modal, focused fullscreen panel, command palette

typography.font-serif: "IBM Plex Serif", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
typography.font-mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

focus-ring.comment: Color del halo de foco. Igual a --ring; usar --ring salvo que necesites el set state-focus-* completo.

focus-offset.comment: Separación del halo de foco respecto del borde.

card-hover-border.comment: Borde de card en hover (patrón hairline-first).

row-hover-bg.comment: Mantenido por paridad shadcn; varias tablas usan --accent directo (audit 2026-06-02).

row-selected-bg.comment: Mantenido por paridad shadcn; varias tablas usan --accent directo.
